sentences.text: The earlier RBI pre-payment charge directions are no longer in force on 2026-11-23, and the 2014 floating-rate term-loan circular is also no longer in force on that date.

For this case, the current UCB rule found applicable says that, in cases other than those covered by its specific exceptions, pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB.

Clause 9.3 requires a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding on foreclosure or pre-payment, but the evidence provided does not include the bank’s approved policy needed to test that condition.

missing.searched: Searched the agreement and RBI rule findings for the bank’s approved policy under the applicable UCB pre-payment rule, but none was provided.
